title: 1956 AHSME Problem 32
statement: George and Henry started a race from opposite ends of the pool. After a minute and a half, they passed each other in the center of the pool. If they lost no time in turning and maintained their respective speeds, how many minutes after starting did they pass each other the second time?

solutions.text:
Because they started simultaneously from opposite ends and first met at the center, their speeds are equal. Each reaches the opposite end after \(3\) minutes. They turn immediately, and each then needs another \(1.5\) minutes to return to the center, where they meet again. The second meeting occurs after \[ 3+1.5=4.5=4\frac12 \] minutes.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Meeting at the center means the two swimmers have equal speeds
They reach the opposite ends at \(3\) minutes, turn, and need another half-pool each
